Name: Funny_TooLittle_1
Text: Could have been a lot funnier.

Name: Funny_TooLittle_2
Text: I did not crack a single smile.

Name: Funny_TooLittle_3
Text: The jokes landed in some other theater.

Name: Funny_TooMuch_1
Text: Less slapstick and more story please.

Name: Funny_TooMuch_2
Text: It is a comedy that forgot to be a movie.

Name: Funny_TooMuch_3
Text: Every scene is a punchline. Exhausting.

Name: Scary_TooLittle_1
Text: Nothing here would frighten a sleeping cat.

Name: Scary_TooLittle_2
Text: Where is the dread? I am still waiting for it.

Name: Scary_TooLittle_3
Text: Too safe. I wanted to check under my bed afterwards.

Name: Scary_TooMuch_1
Text: Way too scary for me.

Name: Scary_TooMuch_2
Text: I had to leave the room twice. Not a compliment.

Name: Scary_TooMuch_3
Text: Subtle would have been nice. This was a fright attack.

Name: Brave_TooLittle_1
Text: The hero hides in every scene. Be bolder.

Name: Brave_TooLittle_2
Text: Where is the courage? All I saw was waiting.

Name: Brave_TooLittle_3
Text: Nobody here takes a real risk.

Name: Brave_TooMuch_1
Text: The hero is reckless to the point of nonsense.

Name: Brave_TooMuch_2
Text: Bravery is fine but these stunts are just reckless.

Name: Brave_TooMuch_3
Text: Every problem is solved by charging head first. Tiring.

Name: Thoughtful_TooLittle_1
Text: Pretty to look at but nothing to think about afterwards.

Name: Thoughtful_TooLittle_2
Text: The plot never asks anything of me.

Name: Thoughtful_TooLittle_3
Text: Shallow. I expected a little more to chew on.

Name: Thoughtful_TooMuch_1
Text: Too much talking. I came for a movie not a lecture.

Name: Thoughtful_TooMuch_2
Text: I got lost in the metaphors and gave up.

Name: Thoughtful_TooMuch_3
Text: Heavy handed. Just tell me the story.

Name: Romantic_TooLittle_1
Text: Not a single spark between the leads.

Name: Romantic_TooLittle_2
Text: I was rooting for a kiss that never came.

Name: Romantic_TooLittle_3
Text: Cold romance. Even the couple seemed bored.

Name: Romantic_TooMuch_1
Text: Enough with the love scenes. The plot is missing.

Name: Romantic_TooMuch_2
Text: Syrupy. My teeth hurt.

Name: Romantic_TooMuch_3
Text: The romance swallowed the whole film.
